name: Send Stripe customers a PDF receipt

parameters.content:
## Send Stripe customers a PDF receipt

### How it works

This workflow starts when a Stripe payment succeeds, retrieves the related customer, and checks that the payment has a usable customer record. It builds a branded, VAT-inclusive receipt model, verifies the customer has an email address, renders a PDF receipt, then emails it to the customer and archives it in Google Drive. Along the way, failed prerequisites or delivery/archive issues are routed to an actionable error record.

### Setup steps

- Configure Stripe credentials for both the Stripe trigger and customer lookup, and select the successful payment event to listen for.
- Update the branding Set node with the seller name, address, VAT ID, and sender email details.
- Configure pdfMint with the receipt template or HTML used to generate the branded PDF.
- Connect Gmail credentials and set the sender, recipient mapping, subject, body, and PDF attachment field.
- Connect Google Drive credentials and choose the destination folder for archived receipts.
- Review the conditional checks and error fields so missing customer, missing email, PDF generation failure, or delivery/archive problems are recorded clearly.

### Customization

You can customize the receipt branding fields, VAT/formatting logic in the code node, the PDF template, the email copy, and the Google Drive archive location.

## Receive and validate payment

The left-side entry cluster listens for successful Stripe payments, fetches the attached customer, and branches if no customer is available.

## Build receipt data

This central cluster applies seller branding, constructs the human-readable receipt model from Stripe payment data, and checks whether the customer has an email address.

## Render and verify PDF

This cluster generates the branded PDF receipt with pdfMint and confirms that a PDF was returned before downstream delivery and archiving continue.

## Deliver archive and log

The right-side output cluster emails the PDF receipt, stores a copy in Google Drive, and records actionable errors from validation, rendering, email, or archive paths.

parameters.message:
=

Hello {{ $('Generate Receipt Model').item.json.customer_name }},

Thank you for your payment of {{ $('Generate Receipt Model').item.json.gross_display }}. Your branded receipt is attached.

Please keep it for your records.
parameters.subject: ={{ 'Your receipt ' + $('Generate Receipt Model').item.json.receipt_number }}

assignments.name: stage
assignments.value: ={{ $json.error ? 'delivery_or_archive' : (!$('Stripe Payment Success Trigger').first().json.data.object.customer ? 'customer_missing' : (!$('Generate Receipt Model').isExecuted ? 'customer_lookup' : (!$('Generate Receipt Model').first().json.customer_email ? 'email_missing' : 'pdf_render'))) }}

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: ={{ $json.error?.message || $json.error || 'Receipt processing stopped because the payment has no usable Stripe customer, the customer has no email address, or PDF rendering failed.' }}

assignments.name: action_required
assignments.value: Review this execution, correct the customer or connected service, then retry it.
